params.treasury_: Initial treasury address for fee withdrawals.
params.trustedSigner_: Backend hot-wallet that signs score attestations.

returns.used: True if the pair has been consumed.

mintBoast(address,uint256,string,uint256.details: Flow:         1. Caller must have approved this contract for at least `boastFee`            cUSD before calling.         2. The backend signs `keccak256(abi.encodePacked(player, score,            gameMode, nonce))` using eth_sign (which prepends the            Ethereum signed-message prefix before hashing).         3. The recovered signer must match `trustedSigner`.         4. `(player, nonce)` is marked used — replay protection.         5. cUSD is pulled from the caller and held in this contract.         6. Attestation is stored and `BoastMinted` emitted.

params.nonce: Per-player unique nonce issued by the backend.
params.player: The player wallet being attested (may differ from                  msg.sender if a relayer is used, but signature commits                  to this address so it cannot be spoofed).
params.score: Raw score value from the game session.
params.signature: 65-byte ECDSA signature from the trusted backend signer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.newTreasury: New treasury address.  Must be non-zero.

params.newSigner: New signer address.  Must be non-zero.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdrawFees().details: Only the owner may call this.  Reverts if there is nothing to         withdraw so you don't pay gas for a no-op.

params.amount: Amount in cUSD wei to withdraw.

boastFee().notice: Fee in cUSD (18-decimal wei) required per attestation.         Settable by owner.  Default: 0.99 cUSD.

cUSD().notice: The cUSD ERC-20 token used for payment (immutable after deploy).

getAttestation(uint256).notice: Fetch the full attestation record for a given boastId.

isNonceUsed(address,uint256).notice: Check whether a (player, nonce) pair has already been used.

setBoastFee(uint256).notice: Update the boast fee.  Must be > 0.

setTrustedSigner(address).notice: Update the trusted backend signer address.

totalBoasts().notice: Total number of attestations minted (also the last boastId).

treasury().notice: Treasury address that receives withdrawn fees.         Settable by owner.

trustedSigner().notice: Backend address whose ECDSA signatures authorise attestations.         Settable by owner.

withdrawFees().notice: Withdraw all accumulated cUSD fees to the treasury address.

withdrawFees(uint256).notice: Withdraw a specific amount of cUSD fees to the treasury.
